AutoIML: Gate-based AutoML/IML workflow

Source: R/AutoIMLBase.R
AutoIML.Rd

AutoIML: Gate-based AutoML/IML workflow

AutoIML: Gate-based AutoML/IML workflow

Format

R6::R6Class object.

Details

AutoIML orchestrates a gate-based interpretability workflow (G0A, G0B, G1-G6, G7A, G7B) for mlr3 tasks and learners. It produces a reproducible audit trail and data-/task-dependent interpretability artifacts.

This is the earlier AutoIML workflow, kept for compatibility. Its gate identifiers and pass/warn/fail/skip labels are not the CSDG gate registry (csdg_gate_registry()) or its vocabulary; use csdg_audit() for CSDG.

Run the workflow with $run(); inspect results with $overview() and $report_card(); retrieve non-plot tables via $tables(); and generate ggplot2 outputs via $plot(type=...).

See also

autoiml() for a functional wrapper.

Public fields

task

(mlr3::Task) The task to be analyzed.

learner

(mlr3::Learner) The learner used to fit the predictive model.

resampling

(mlr3::Resampling) Resampling strategy used for performance estimation (Gate 1) and stability checks.

purpose

(character(1)) Purpose of the analysis. Controls defaults and the overall claim scope.

quick_start

(logical(1)) If TRUE, use a lighter configuration (fewer or cheaper artifacts).

seed

(integer(1)) Random seed used for stochastic components.

profile

(character(1)) Configuration profile: "high_resolution" or "fast".

ctx

(list) Mutable context/configuration passed to gates. You may set auto$ctx$... before calling $run().

gates

(list) List of gate objects to execute (G0A..G7B).

result

(AutoIMLResult) Latest result produced by $run().

Method new()

Create a new AutoIML runner.

Usage

AutoIML$new(
  task,
  learner,
  resampling,
  purpose = c("exploratory", "global_insight", "decision_support", "deployment"),
  profile = c("high_resolution", "fast"),
  quick_start = FALSE,
  seed = 1L,
  config = list()
)

Arguments

task

(mlr3::Task) Task to analyze.

learner

(mlr3::Learner) Learner used to fit the predictive model.

resampling

(mlr3::Resampling) Resampling strategy used for Gate 1 and related diagnostics.

purpose

(character(1)) Intended use. Influences the default analysis scope and which gates are executed.

profile

(character(1)) Configuration profile: "high_resolution" (default) or "fast".

quick_start

(logical(1)) If TRUE, reduce compute (fewer artifacts, smaller samples).

seed

(integer(1)) Random seed for stochastic steps.

config

(list) Optional configuration list merged into ctx. You can provide a claim specification via config = list(claim = list(...)), which is validated in Gate 0.

Returns

A new AutoIML object.

Method run()

Execute all configured gates and return an AutoIMLResult.

The resulting object contains the per-gate GateResult objects, timing information, and all computed artifacts. The latest result is also stored in the $result field.

Usage

AutoIML$run(verbose = FALSE)

Arguments

verbose

(logical(1)) If TRUE, prints the report card at the end of the run.

Returns

(AutoIMLResult) Result object containing all gate outputs.

Method report_card()

Return the report card for the most recent $run() call.

This is the same table as report_card() but scoped to the object.

Usage

AutoIML$report_card()

Returns

A data.table with one row per gate.

Method report_card_extended()

Return the extended requirement-level report card for the latest run.

Usage

AutoIML$report_card_extended()

Returns

A data.table with one row per framework requirement.

Return key tables produced by the workflow.

AutoIML$tables(which = c("all", "g0", "g2", "g6"), ...)

Arguments

Method overview()

Print a structured overview of the latest run (audit trail).

Usage

AutoIML$overview()

Returns

Invisibly returns self.

Method plot()

Create ggplot2-based visual outputs from the latest run.

Usage

AutoIML$plot(type, ...)

Arguments

type

(character(1)) Plot type identifier. Supported values:

Gate-specific:

  • "g1_scores": Gate 1 CV score trend over folds.

  • "g2_effect": Gate 2 global effect (PDP/ALE) with optional ICE overlay.

  • "g2_ice_spread": Gate 2 ICE heterogeneity summary.

  • "g2_hstats": Gate 2 interaction screening (Friedman H-statistics).

  • "g2_ale_2d": Gate 2 ALE interaction surface heatmap for top interacting pair.

  • "g2_gadget": Gate 2 regionalized local-effect curves (if available).

  • "g2_gadget_tree": Gate 2 GADGET split tree / split-gain summary.

  • "g2_pint": Gate 2 optional GADGET-PINT interaction screen.

  • "g3_calibration": Gate 3 reliability (calibration) curve.

  • "g3_dca": Gate 3 decision curve analysis (net benefit vs threshold).

  • "g5_stability": Gate 5 permutation importance with bootstrap CIs.

  • "g6_performance": Gate 6 alternative learner performance comparison.

  • "g6_group_performance": Gate 6 subgroup performance heterogeneity.

  • "g6_rashomon_importance": Gate 6 Rashomon explanation dispersion.

  • "g6_rank_heatmap": Gate 6 feature importance rank heatmap across Rashomon members.

  • "g6_pred_multiplicity": Gate 6 per-row prediction range histogram across Rashomon members.

  • "g6_loco": Gate 6 leave-one-out transport bar chart (requires LOCO transport mode).

  • "g6_summary": Gate 6 composite (performance + importance).

  • "g7a_subgroups": Gate 7A subgroup performance bar chart.

SHAP / Shapley:

  • "shap_local": Local SHAP waterfall for a selected row.

  • "shap_importance": Global SHAP mean(|phi|) bar chart.

  • "shap_beeswarm": Global SHAP beeswarm plot.

Composite:

  • "gate_strip": Colored tile strip showing pass/warn/fail/skip per gate.

  • "overview": Claim-adaptive multi-panel gate evidence overview (requires patchwork).

...

Additional arguments forwarded to the selected plot helper.

Returns

A ggplot object or a patchwork composition.

Method shap()

Compute local Shapley values (SHAP) for one observation.

Internally uses a Shapley value decomposition (via the iml package), wrapped to work on mlr3 learners.

Usage

AutoIML$shap(
  row_id,
  class_label = NULL,
  sample_size = 100L,
  background_n = 200L,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

row_id

(integer(1) | character(1)) Row id of the observation to explain (must exist in task).

class_label

(character(1) | NULL) For classification tasks, the class to explain. Defaults to the first class level if NULL. Ignored for regression.

sample_size

(integer(1)) Number of Monte Carlo samples used for the Shapley estimation.

background_n

(integer(1)) Number of background observations used for the reference distribution.

seed

(integer(1) | NULL) Optional seed for reproducibility.

Returns

A data.table with feature-level Shapley contributions.

Method clone()

The objects of this class are cloneable with this method.

Usage

AutoIML$clone(deep = FALSE)

Arguments

deep

Whether to make a deep clone.

Examples

library(mlr3)
#> Warning: package ‘mlr3’ was built under R version 4.5.2
task = tsk("penguins")
learner = lrn("classif.rpart", predict_type = "prob")
resampling = rsmp("cv", folds = 5)
auto = AutoIML$new(task = task, learner = learner, resampling = resampling,
  purpose = "global_insight", quick_start = FALSE, seed = 123)
result = auto$run(verbose = TRUE)
